question: Having opened its Twitter account in _______, the Reserve Bank of India had more than 1 million followers on its official Twitter handle by November 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is** ​**__**January 2012**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Having opened its Twitter account in **January 2012**, the Reserve Bank of India had more than 1 million followers on its official Twitter handle by November 2020.
 
• RBI becomes the **world’s first monetary authority** with a million Twitter followers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reserve Bank of India**

 
 
• **​**The Reserve Bank of India was established on **April 1, 1935**.
 
• RBI is a **statutory body**.
 
• It is responsible for** printing currency notes and managing the supply of money** in the Indian economy.
 
• The Reserve Bank of India is the **highest monetary authority in India**.
 
• It also serves as the government's representative to the International Monetary Fund and represents India's membership.
